name: THE HOTEL LOBBY
note: Room 18, doc 20. ERRATA 34's asymmetry, and the room that sets the pattern: the back wall sits left of centre, the right-hand wall runs much longer, and the stair climbs it. Composed to the frozen standard; NO HOTSPOTS YET. The examine layer arrives with the document being written for this room -- a hotspot with no line is worse than no hotspot, and check-examine-lines says so. Every door here is marked stub for the same reason: the destination exists so the exit works and the lines are honestly absent rather than invented.
materialIdentity: Worn blue-grey plush and tarnished brass (30d) -- the only interior in Act I with a BLUE cast. The assay office is achromatic cold; nothing else in Act I may go blue

paletteScript.note: ERRATA 23's proportions and 30f's step 0, committed from renders/interior-identity-plan. Dominant 55-70%, structural shadow 15-25%, secondary local colour 10-15%, narrative accent 3-8%.

entrances.note: In off the street, at the near end of the lobby with the desk ahead.
Down the stair, which climbs the long right-hand wall.

lightSources.note: The desk lamp. One oil lamp against a cool field, per errata 30d, with 33a's dark collar around it.
